name: skynet-mcp
description: Skynet AI cluster orchestrator for autonomous Minecraft server management, including construction automation, RCON command execution, Git-based blueprint versioning, vision audit, and NPU inference on the Stargate host.

skills.name: Minecraft Construction
skills.description: Autonomous schematic generation and block placement via RCON for in-game building automation.
examples: Build a medieval castle at coordinates x=100 y=64 z=200
Generate a redstone circuit schematic from description

skills.name: Minecraft Administration
skills.description: Server administration via RCON: player management, world editing, CoreProtect queries, and WorldGuard region control.
examples: List all players currently on the server
Roll back the last 50 actions at a specific location

skills.name: Blueprint Versioning
skills.description: Git-backed version control for Minecraft schematics and blueprints with automated commit workflows.
examples: Commit all recent schematic changes to the blueprint repository
Show git log for the last 10 blueprint commits

skills.name: Vision Terrain Audit
skills.description: Edge TPU-powered visual analysis and terrain auditing of Minecraft builds using spatial snapshots.
examples: Audit the recent build at sector 7 for structural compliance
Generate a spatial snapshot of the current server state

skills.name: AI Inference
skills.description: Hailo-8L NPU-accelerated inference for T2BM (Text-to-Build) model and schematic generation tasks.
examples: Generate a building schematic from the prompt dragon lair
Run text-to-building inference on the submitted description
